title: Burned area per first-level region and year (MCD64A1 v6.1) - Southeast Asia, 11 countries

units.burned_ha: hectares with a burn date in the year (first burn per pixel per year)
units.burned_on_peat_ha: burned ha x CIFOR peat area fraction of each 500 m cell
units.burned_on_forest2000_ha: burned ha x fraction of the cell with Hansen treecover2000 >= 30 %

notes: Source: NASA LP DAAC MCD64A1 v6.1 BurnDate, 2001-2025; pixel counted once per year (first burn day), so a pixel burning twice in a year counts once.
Pixel hectares from the authalic sphere (R 6371.0088 km); regions rasterised on the 500 m grid, so boundaries are +-250 m.
"On peat" and "on forest" are area-weighted approximations (fraction of the 500 m cell), not pixel-exact overlays.
No monthly series (burned_ha_monthly) in this file for the countries added after Indonesia/Malaysia/Brunei/Singapore: the annual burned masks for them have no day of year.
Regions: geoBoundaries ADM1; burned ha outside the polygons is in all_pixels_ha; each country is counted on its own.
Indonesian, Malaysian, Brunei and Singapore series are the live / tier-B values unchanged (a rebuild of them in the same run matched; see build report).
Series 'all' = sum of the 11 national series (null where any country has no data for the field).
